fields.why: Fill percentages and AAPCs are given for 6 age groups; the Table tests each age group against 20–24 years, and the text says the decline 'varied fourfold by age group'.
Sex is a pair (women vs men within each age group); age is the only SPD with 3 or more groups compared.

The Table's chi-square marks are each age group vs 20–24 years (per-group vs referent); the AAPCs by age are tested only against zero and the Joinpoint parallelism tests compare men vs women, so the age comparison of trends is side by side and the flag is a false alarm.
